tools.name: refund_and_archive_invoice
tools.description: Issues a refund for a paid invoice through Stripe and moves the invoice record from the active invoices table to the refunded invoices archive table.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing")
DATABASE_PATH = "billing.db"


@mcp.tool()
def refund_and_archive_invoice(invoice_id: str, refund_amount_cents: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    invoice_row_with_payment_intent = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT payment_intent_id FROM active_invoices WHERE id = ?", (invoice_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if invoice_row_with_payment_intent is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return "Invoice not found"
    created_refund_object = stripe.Refund.create(
        payment_intent=invoice_row_with_payment_intent[0], amount=refund_amount_cents
    )
    database_connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO refunded_invoices SELECT * FROM active_invoices WHERE id = ?", (invoice_id,)
    )
    database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM active_invoices WHERE id = ?", (invoice_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return created_refund_object.id

tools.name: run_invoice_generation_job
tools.description: Runs the monthly invoice generation script for a billing period and returns its exit status and output.

params.name: dry_run
params.description: Pass the dry-run flag to the script

tools.code:
import re
import subprocess

SCRIPT_PATH = "/opt/billing/scripts/generate_invoices.py"


def run_invoice_generation_job(billing_period: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict:
    result = {"billing_period": billing_period, "dry_run": dry_run}
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])", billing_period):
        result["ok"] = False
        result["error"] = "billing_period must be YYYY-MM"
        return result
    command = ["python3", SCRIPT_PATH, "--period", billing_period]
    if dry_run:
        command.append("--dry-run")
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        result["ok"] = False
        result["error"] = "timed out"
        return result
    result["ok"] = completed.returncode == 0
    result["exit_code"] = completed.returncode
    result["stdout"] = completed.stdout[-2000:]
    result["stderr"] = completed.stderr[-2000:]
    return result

tools.name: email_invoice_with_payment_link
tools.description: Emails an invoice to a recipient with a pay-online link, and grants that recipient access to view and pay the invoice.
tools.code:
import re
import requests

BILLING_API = "https://billing.internal.example.com/api"
EMAIL_API = "https://mail.internal.example.com/send"


def email_invoice_with_payment_link(invoice_id: str, recipient_email: str) -> str:
    if not invoice_id:
        return "error: invoice_id required"
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+", recipient_email):
        return "error: invalid email"
    grant = requests.post(
        f"{BILLING_API}/invoices/{invoice_id}/access",
        json={"email": recipient_email, "role": "payer"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    if not grant.ok:
        return "error: could not grant access"
    link = grant.json()["payment_url"]
    sent = requests.post(
        EMAIL_API,
        json={"to": recipient_email, "subject": f"Invoice {invoice_id}", "body": f"Pay here: {link}"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    return "sent" if sent.ok else "error: email failed"
